notes.title: Steam Developer Update #2
notes.notes: [p]Hello, fans of Element-174! This is Knotty here to provide another update on how things are coming along regarding Element-174 Part 2. Work continues on the next installment of the game so here's what's new.[/p][p]First off, since the last dev update here, I've managed to finish all of in-game day 19 with work continuing on day 20. Day 20 is about half way done, with another load of content featured in it. Each of these days contains about as much content as several days in the original Element-174 as the branches get more elaborate with multiple possibilities depending on which relationships the player has active. There are a few days which are even entirely different based certain factors. As a reminder, Part 2 will go up to in-game day 21 when the player will decide which character they want as their primary love interest. After that, Part 3 will be entirely focused on that character's story and choices they've made up to that point. Any secondary partners will still be present, so don't think they're going anywhere![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41628074/fb6c6068785a5bcbe1ffb0447a4e8e029fb5939c.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The next piece of news is the fact that I've acquired all new hardware in order to speed up all future development. It's been almost a month since I've migrated everything I need to continue work and the results are impressive. For example, a single still image previously took 5 minutes (such as the one above) to render on average. Now, that same image can be rendered in about 1.75 minutes. A major upgrade for sure and was extremely necessary to meet the guidelines I set for myself.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41628074/25fc7aa6f738d72ab1b6d94a16c8f0aa32ed84fd.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Which brings us to the estimated released date. I previously stated that Part 2 would be released around end of Q4 this year. That date still holds up with a more honed in time frame of November being probable. However, with this new hardware, October is even possible. I'm going to pause work on finishing day 20 to begin work on animating the trailer for Part 2, so that I can get the Steam store page up as soon as possible. I would like to have the Steam page up for about 2-3 months before the official release and taking care of that now allows me to focus on the game during that timeline. So expect the Steam page and trailer to be released soon as the next part of development![/p]

notes.title: Steam Developer Update #1
notes.notes:
Hello fans of Element-174! It's been a few months since I've shared the estimated release schedule for "Part 2," so I thought this would be a good time to update you all on the current process. Right now, day 19 of Element-174 is nearly finished with only one scene left to render. As a reminder, Part 2 will include in-game days 15-21. So work is going well towards reaching the goal of release around end of Q4 this year. It's important to note that even though there will be less in-game days than in Part 1, the content featured will be significantly more than Part 1's. For example, day 19 features almost as many lines of code/dialogue as days 1-6 in Part 1. Similarly, day 19 has almost as many images as days 1-6 (~828 vs 872). So you can see why it takes a while to develop!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41628074/23ef5bfe2d5ba17798265086330bf8eb3f0eae95.jpg[/img]
Day 20 will be slightly larger in size than day 19 with around 23 scenes (4 more than day 19). Like many of the days in week 3 of the game, they will feature solo scenes for each of the 16 love interests, as well as shared scenes between simultaneous characters. In fact, about half the content in Part 2 will be comprised of the numerous throuple routes. These combinations will also influence the storylines for what will eventually be the final chapter of the game, "Element-174 Part 3."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41628074/377c583b73db4ba56e24e67c6b2e5396d6e3d04c.jpg[/img]
I'll continue to provide updates on the development cycle as we get closer to September. In the meantime, I'll be working on trying to code, write and render the game, so that it meets the expectations of all those who have patiently waited. Until then!

notes.title: Release Schedule for Element-174 Part 2
notes.notes:
Hello fans of Element-174! It's amazing how almost a year flies by in a blink. I've just come here to give an update on the release of Element-174 Part 2. To refresh, the current plan was to have Part 2 cover in-game days 15-21. As of right now, day 19 is the closest to being completed which means unfortunately there's still a little ways to go before Part 2 is ready for release. This means that part 2 won't be available in time for the originally estimated goal of Q1 2025.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41628074/489e1004c2f21ac452fc3c3183a2b893fc51a324.jpg[/img]

With almost all of Element-174 being developed by me (Knotty), the process can be slow and laborious, but ultimately satisfying. Seeing the response that players have towards the games and its characters is so rewarding, even if it often doesn't come out in a timely manner. I want to put out a game that I can be proud of and not just rush out slop.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41628074/687b8cd660061ad3b1fdffd27ac83765fa4f47eb.jpg[/img]

With that in mind, I want to apologize for the delays and update the current timeline for the release of Element-174 Part 2. At the current rate of work (and with added hustle) I'm hoping that it can be available around the end of Q3. However, there is always the possibility that it may take longer. Sometimes life gets in the way and throws hiccups into the best made plans, but it's never for lack of effort. I will also try to provide more previews and updates here on Steam, as work continues on the remaining day 19-21 content. Thanks again for your patience and know that the game will be worth the wait once it's ready!

notes.title: News Update for Element-174 Part 2
notes.notes:
It's been a while since the last update so it was about time to share what the status is for Element-174 Part 2. The next chapter of the story is still being worked on, but is more than half complete. Progress has been slow since the development team is tiny (consisting mostly of myself). So we thank you for your patience with waiting for the DLC to be released. That being said, the estimated release schedule for "Part 2" is slotted for [b]Q1 of 2025[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41628074/0a4eb6633ab25bc3310ce040ba9068db95dc4aa6.jpg[/img]

So what should you expect from the next section of the game? Well, "Part 2" will feature 7 more in-game days taking the story to day 21. Even though there will only be 7 days (as opposed to Part 1's fourteen days), there is actually more content to experience. As an example, some of the days contain half as many lines of code as all of days 1-7 combined! Week 3 also features a lot more adult content with your favorite Element-174 characters than was available in Part 1. This includes more animations, as well as "shared" scenes between certain pairings that the main character romances.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41628074/d5d50c749b0cebe858676a79b885c401ff421899.jpg[/img]

With that said, Part 2 was originally intended to encompass all of the second half of Element-174's story. However, since there was so much content to week 3 (as well as how long it's taken to make it), a decision was made to add the final week of Element-174's story as "Part 3" to be released sometime later. Otherwise, there would be an even longer wait for content. We thank you for your patience and hope that when you play "Element-174 Part 2," that you'll have as much fun playing it as we've had making it. I'm really looking forward to it!

notes.title: Animation Update is here!
notes.notes:
Well it's finally here, folks! The "Animation Update" is complete and adds [i][b]102 animated clips[/b][/i] throughout the various scenes of Element-174. Most of these occur during the game's spicier content so there's plenty to discover across the 16 routes. As well, these animations can also be viewed under the game's replay section for content that you've already unlocked.

It was a challenge to learn how to animate these clips, but over the past few months it got easier each time. Soon the animations were getting pumped out and after about 100 of them, it doesn't seem unlikely that the game might receive another update down the line that adds another batch of animations. For now, we hope you enjoy these and look forward to more! Until next time!

notes.title: Animation Update Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
It's been several months now since the release of Element-174 - Part 1 on Steam and one of the features that has been requested most in that time is animations. Well we're pleased to announce that that wish will finally be granted this summer. Sometime in early August we'll be adding all new animations to the game for the love scenes in Element-174!

These will be fit in seamlessly with the story that you all know and love, as well as during the game's replay mode. With all these new additions, it will be the perfect time to experience the game in a new way (or possibly exploring unseen branches). And the best part is that this update will be entirely free!

Expect the animation update to be released here on Steam in early August. Until then!
